nodes.text:
Heavy. Patient. Went down slow, like it was deciding...

Yes. There is a word for that, in the old tongue, and I will not translate it, and my not translating it is the kindest sentence I have said this year. Tell Denna this instead: bring a stormpearl to her quay. My people used them to listen to deep water. Her line may hear more than most, and what she does with the listening is hers.
